pkgmetadata.longdescription: Tencent Meeting video conferencing client. On ARM64 systems using 16 KiB kernel pages, this package carries Fedora's Chromium 87 PartitionAlloc backport for Qt5 WebEngine and repacks libImSDK so the client can run natively with working web login and host media devices.
腾讯会议Linux客户端。对于采用16 KiB内核页的ARM64系统，本包集成 Fedora为Qt5 WebEngine移植的Chromium 87 PartitionAlloc修复，并重排 libImSDK，使客户端能够原生运行、使用网页扫码登录及宿主媒体设备。
